title: OTRI race result record

rank.description: Finishing position, or a non-finisher code (DNF, DNS, DSQ).

finish_time.description: Finish time as H:MM:SS (fractional seconds allowed; MM:SS accepted for short races). Required when rank is a finishing position; omitted for DNF/DNS/DSQ rows.

gender.description: M, F or X. The ingestion validator also accepts Male/Female/Man/Woman and several languages and normalises them; anything else is a warning, since organizer data is not always pre-cleaned.

bib_number.description: Race bib as printed; letters allowed.

status.description: Optional. Finisher, DNF, DNS or DSQ (common spellings accepted). A non-finisher status may replace the rank for that row.

birth_year.description: Optional four-digit year of birth, when a full birthdate is not shared.

description: One row per participant, one file per race distance. Header names follow common timing exports (Rank/Position/Place, Time/Net time/Chip time, Last name/Surname, First name, Gender/Sex, Status, Bib, Nationality/Country, Birthdate/DOB, YOB, City, Team/Club); see ingestion/schema.py for every accepted variant.
